name: Saginomiya Rei
source:
A 3rd year student belonging to "The Roses in Full Bloom" class.

The second oldest son of the Saginomiya family, whose members have Imperial blood running through their veins. Since Rei, like Riku, has a large profile within the academy, Rei is called "Haku Bara-sama" ("Lord White Rose"), and is a much-loved figure. He's kind to anybody regardless of their social class, but does not readily show others his true feelings. In spite of his refined appearance, Rei has a large interest in mechanical engineering. As a hobby, he assembles robots.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/04/28/zettai-kaikyuu-gakuen-eden-with-roses-and-phantasm/]Otome Jikan[/URL].]
